# Clean, scalable hydrogen energy

H-Power engineers zero-emissions hydrogen energy systems designed to deliver reliable power for
demanding off-grid applications.

[ About us ][55] [ Products & Technology ][56]
**About us**

## We are H-Power

H‑Power develops clean, zero‑emissions hydrogen energy systems designed for real‑world use. We use
ammonia to produce low‑carbon hydrogen at the point of need, and fuel cells to convert hydrogen into
reliable, off‑grid power, providing a practical, scalable alternative to fossil fuels.

[ H-Power at a glance ][57]
**Products & Technology**

## Our products

H‑Power delivers hydrogen production and hydrogen‑to‑power technologies, each designed to solve a
different part of the hydrogen‑to‑power challenge. The HY5 ammonia cracker produces low‑carbon
hydrogen on‑site and on‑demand, while the LC30 hydrogen fuel cell generator converts hydrogen from
the HY5 or any other supply into clean, quiet and reliable electrical power.

• Scalable throughput via parallel units

# Alpha 50

## ALPHA 50, The plant that changes everything. Large Scale Project Execution Redefined.

Meet the world's first full-scope
50 MW Green Hydrogen plant.

Powered by our state-of-the-art TRIDENT stack platform, ALPHA 50 produces high-purity hydrogen at 30
bar pressure. ALPHA 50 offers superior energy efficiency and is capable of load changes within
seconds to maximise hydrogen output.

50 MEGAWATTS

900 KG/HR H2

### Green Hydrogen, produced by PEM electrolysers and powered by renewable energy is the only
### net-zero fuel source. 

 

### Unlike other fuels, it doesn’t remove oxygen from the atmosphere – or add more water vapour to
### the atmosphere than it consumes during production – which helps retain the earth’s existing
### oxygen and water balance. 

 

### What’s more, it has no negative impact on air quality.

A trusted name in high-power and high-use PEM fuel cell systems, backed by over 25 years of

### **Where we make the ****difference**

We focus on sectors where reliable, high-power hydrogen solutions create the greatest impact. From
off-grid power  maritime and critical infrastructure, our technology supports the transition to
cleaner, more resilient energy systems.

## 01

#### Maritime & Ports

Maritime needs clean power that performs. Our fuel cells supply silent, emission-free energy for
vessels, port equipment and shore power systems. Built to handle harsh marine conditions and
certified to meet international standards, our systems help maritime operators meet climate targets
without slowing down.

#### Off-grid Power

Where the grid ends, we begin. Our systems provide dependable, autonomous power in remote locations,
isolated facilities and backup-critical sites. No emissions, no noise, minimal maintenance. Just
clean hydrogen energy ready when you need it. Energy independence starts here.

## 02

[Build ]

## 03

#### Renewables & Grid

Renewables need stability. Our systems turn intermittent green power into continuous clean power. We
help manage load, avoid curtailment and enable smart energy storage. When the wind drops or the sun
sets, Nedstack keeps the power flowing and the grid ready.

#### Industry

Heavy industry runs on reliability. Our fuel cell systems deliver clean, consistent and
high-efficiency power for demanding environments. From chemicals to manufacturing, we keep
operations running with zero emissions and low maintenance. When power is critical, Nedstack
provides the confidence to move forward without compromise.

## 04

## 05

#### Automotive & Heavy Duty Transport

Transport runs on power density and uptime. Our PEM fuel cells deliver clean traction and auxiliary
power for trucks, buses, and port or construction equipment. Hydrogen enables fast refuel and long
operating hours with silent operation. Modular systems integrate with batteries and vehicle controls
to match duty cycles from urban delivery to heavy haul.

### **Fuel cell systems that ****deliver**

We build what the application demands. From modular stacks to fully integrated power systems. Every
product is engineered for **performance**, **efficiency** and **real-world reliability**. Designed
to operate where failure is not an option.

## PemGen 3

The Generation 3 is a modular hydrogen fuel cells system, producing electricity and heat only
emitting water. It‘s unique design separates the fuel cell module from the air supply, enabling
easier integration optimal operation. This next step in the PEMFC systems, enhances efficiency and
accelerates sustainability in power generation.

## PemGen M

The PemGen M is a compact yet powerful hydrogen fuel cell system delivering up to 175 kW of clean
electricity, emitting only heat and water. Built with robust, automotive-grade components, it
ensures durable and versatile performance in both mobile and stationary applications. With
electrical efficiencies of up to 54%, the system combines reliability and high performance in a
compact, emission-free power solution.

## PemGen M XXL

The PemGen Mobile XXL is a standalone, plug-and-play hydrogen fuel cell system in a 20ft container.
With integrated batteries and built-in vantilation, it ensures efficient cooling and seamless
operation. Producing only water as a by product, it delivers reliable, emission-free power for
flexible and sustainable energy solutions anywhere.

## 01

#### Maritime & Ports

Maritime needs clean power that performs. Our fuel cells supply silent, emission-free energy for
vessels, port equipment and shore power systems. Built to handle harsh marine conditions and
certified to meet international standards, our systems help maritime operators meet climate targets
without slowing down.

#### Off-grid Power

Where the grid ends, we begin. Our systems provide dependable, autonomous power in remote locations,
isolated facilities and backup-critical sites. No emissions, no noise, minimal maintenance. Just
clean hydrogen energy ready when you need it. Energy independence starts here.

#### Renewables & Grid

Renewables need stability. Our systems turn intermittent green power into continuous clean power. We
help manage load, avoid curtailment and enable smart energy storage. When the wind drops or the sun
sets, Nedstack keeps the power flowing and the grid ready.

#### Industry

Heavy industry runs on reliability. Our fuel cell systems deliver clean, consistent and
high-efficiency power for demanding environments. From chemicals to manufacturing, we keep
operations running with zero emissions and low maintenance. When power is critical, Nedstack
provides the confidence to move forward without compromise.

## 04

## 05

#### Automotive & Heavy Duty Transport

Transport runs on power density and uptime. Our PEM fuel cells deliver clean traction and auxiliary
power for trucks, buses, and port or construction equipment. Hydrogen enables fast refuel and long
operating hours with silent operation. Modular systems integrate with batteries and vehicle controls
to match duty cycles from urban delivery to heavy haul.

We build what the application demands. From modular stacks to fully integrated power systems. Every
product is engineered for **performance**, **efficiency** and **real-world reliability**. Designed
to operate where failure is not an option.

## PemGen 3

The Generation 3 is a modular hydrogen fuel cells system, producing electricity and heat only
emitting water. It‘s unique design separates the fuel cell module from the air supply, enabling
easier integration optimal operation. This next step in the PEMFC systems, enhances efficiency and
accelerates sustainability in power generation.

## PemGen M

The PemGen M is a compact yet powerful hydrogen fuel cell system delivering up to 175 kW of clean
electricity, emitting only heat and water. Built with robust, automotive-grade components, it
ensures durable and versatile performance in both mobile and stationary applications. With
electrical efficiencies of up to 54%, the system combines reliability and high performance in a
compact, emission-free power solution.

The PemGen Mobile XXL is a standalone, plug-and-play hydrogen fuel cell system in a 20ft container.
With integrated batteries and built-in vantilation, it ensures efficient cooling and seamless
operation. Producing only water as a by product, it delivers reliable, emission-free power for
flexible and sustainable energy solutions anywhere.

next generation of fuel cell technology.

renewable fuels like liquid sun and liquid wind tomorrow.

Stationary and mobile fuel cell solutions

## **Resilient Energy Solutions**
## EFOY Fuel Cell vs. Generator

Compared to conventional generators, fuel cell technology provides a cleaner, quieter, and more
resilient energy solution. Designed for continuous, autonomous operation, fuel cells deliver
reliable off-grid power without moving parts, frequent maintenance, or high noise levels — making
them the smarter alternative for mission-critical applications.

## Mobile and off-grid power generation and distribution
## **in all markets**

SFC Energy is a global leader in mobile and off-grid power solutions for the Clean Energy &
Mobility, Public Security, Oil & Gas, and other Industrial markets.

### **Clean Energy**
### Fuel cells and Integrated Solutions

Reliability, self-sufficiency and comfort: SFC Energy's environmentally friendly, silent fuel cell
solutions ensure uninterrupted power supply, whether on board government and recreational vehicles
or in other mobile or stationary off-grid applications.

### Power Products & Electronics

Discover our high-quality custom power supply solutions and specialty coils for highly sensitive,
demanding industrial applications as well as variable frequency drive (VFD) systems as intelligent

## **Resilient Energy Solutions**
## EFOY Fuel Cell vs. Generator

Compared to conventional generators, fuel cell technology provides a cleaner, quieter, and more
resilient energy solution. Designed for continuous, autonomous operation, fuel cells deliver
reliable off-grid power without moving parts, frequent maintenance, or high noise levels — making
them the smarter alternative for mission-critical applications.

## **in all markets**

SFC Energy is a global leader in mobile and off-grid power solutions for the Clean Energy &
Mobility, Public Security, Oil & Gas, and other Industrial markets.

### **Clean Energy**
### Fuel cells and Integrated Solutions

Reliability, self-sufficiency and comfort: SFC Energy's environmentally friendly, silent fuel cell
solutions ensure uninterrupted power supply, whether on board government and recreational vehicles
or in other mobile or stationary off-grid applications.

### Power Products & Electronics

Discover our high-quality custom power supply solutions and specialty coils for highly sensitive,

# With methanol fuel cells we reduce the cost of going green!

[ About us ][88]

ABOUT US

## Developer and manufacturer of methanol fuel cells

Blue World Technologies is an ambitious and visionary cell manufacturer providing methanol fuel cell
components and systems as a green alternative to combustion engines and diesel generators for
hard-to-abate sectors such as the maritime industry and heavy-duty transportation.

[ Read more ][90]
OUR MARITIME VISION

With a starting point providing onboard power generation, we strive towards supplying multi-megawatt
fuel cell systems for both power and propulsion. 

Within the past couple of years, methanol has gained ground and is now, for new orders, the leading
alternative fuel for the maritime industry. But green methanol is a costly fuel and we need to
ensure that we get the most out of it. With our unique system architecture, we reduce the cost of
going green providing:

[Group 5]

Fuel savings of 20-30%

[Group 5]

Up to 100% CO2 recovery for utilisation and storage

[ Read more ][91]

## Blue World’s value chain coverage

With an industrial approach, Blue World Technologies stands out by having all technologies and core
component manufacturing within the methanol fuel cell stack value chain internally in the
organisation, and in some cases even to system level.

Pursuing technological breakthroughs and product development

Manufacturing of materials and components used in the fuel cells

Various end-user applications in close collaboration with OEMs or customers

## When direct electrification isn't enough

Undoubtedly direct electrification will play a significant role in the global transition towards a
fossil-free future. But sometimes direct electrification and battery technology are not possible or
feasible.

Blue World Technologies pushes the green transition forward by providing high energy-efficient
methanol fuel cell technology that enables a cost-competitive use of green fuels.

## A green future with net-zero carbon emission

Renewable methanol plays a significant strategic role as a promising alternative to fossil fuels.

Methanol is an efficient, liquid energy carrier that can be produced from renewable sources. Due to
its liquid nature, methanol can easily and conveniently be stored in large volumes and transported
around the world. Methanol allows for the reuse of the existing global infrastructure without the
need for massive investments in the development of new infrastructure. 

Methanol from biomass and renewable origin also eliminates CO2 emissions from a well-to-wheel
perspective and enables a CO2-neutral or even CO2-negative operation. Furthermore, Blue World
Technologies’ methanol fuel cells significantly reduce NOx, SOx, or particle emissions.

With an increasing global focus on the production of renewable methanol, the way is paved towards a
net-zero carbon emission future.

## Die nächste Generation hocheffizienter Brennstoffzellensysteme

Unser BZA375-Brennstoffzellensystem ist die Antwort auf die Anforderungen im Schwerlast- und
Langstreckentransport. Mehr als 30 Jahre Erfahrung in Entwicklung, Optimierung und Produktion von
Brennstoffzellensystemen mit Schwerpunkt auf dem Automobilbereich fließen in dieses System ein.

## Entwickelt für Schwerlast-Lkw, geeignet für mehr

Unsere neuesten Brennstoffzellensysteme wurden für die Anforderungen von Schwerlast-Lkw entwickelt.
Relevantester technischer Vergleich für unser System sind aktuelle Dieselmotoren, die es Lkw aktuell
ermöglichen, die vergleichsweise längste Strecke pro Tankfüllung zurückzulegen. In den letzten
Jahren haben wir Leistung, Leistungsdichte und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich erheblich verbessert.

## Die Zukunft im Bereich Schwerlast-Lkw

Der Erfolg zukünftiger Nachhaltigkeitsbemühungen wird nicht nur von effizienten
Brennstoffzellensystemen abhängen. Daher ist eine wachsende Wasserstoffinfrastruktur als Basis für
einen größeren Betriebsradius und mehr in Betrieb befindliche Brennstoffzellen-LKWs erforderlich.
Die Wasserstoff-Infrastruktur als Teil des H2-Ecosystems, bei dem cellcentric aktiv unterstützt.

# We power sustainable life

Ziel von cellcentric ist, ein weltweit führender Hersteller von Brennstoffzellen zu werden und damit
der Welt bis 2050 einen großen Schritt in Richtung klimaneutraler und nachhaltiger Mobilität zu
ermöglichen.

[ Mehr erfahren][19]
[BZA375 Launch]

Technologie

## Die nächste Generation hocheffizienter Brennstoffzellensysteme

Unser BZA375-Brennstoffzellensystem ist die Antwort auf die Anforderungen im Schwerlast- und
Langstreckentransport. Mehr als 30 Jahre Erfahrung in Entwicklung, Optimierung und Produktion von
Brennstoffzellensystemen mit Schwerpunkt auf dem Automobilbereich fließen in dieses System ein.

[ Mehr erfahren][20]
[Fünf moderne LKWs fahren im Kolonne-Testbetrieb auf einer Asphaltstrecke neben grüner Böschung.]
Anwendungen

## Entwickelt für Schwerlast-Lkw, geeignet für mehr

Unsere neuesten Brennstoffzellensysteme wurden für die Anforderungen von Schwerlast-Lkw entwickelt.
Relevantester technischer Vergleich für unser System sind aktuelle Dieselmotoren, die es Lkw aktuell
ermöglichen, die vergleichsweise längste Strecke pro Tankfüllung zurückzulegen. In den letzten
Jahren haben wir Leistung, Leistungsdichte und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich erheblich verbessert.

[ Mehr erfahren][21]
[Nahaufnahme eines flüssigen Wasserstofftanks an einem LKW mit angeschlossenem Befüllanschluss.]
Wasserstoff

## Die Zukunft im Bereich Schwerlast-Lkw

Der Erfolg zukünftiger Nachhaltigkeitsbemühungen wird nicht nur von effizienten
Brennstoffzellensystemen abhängen. Daher ist eine wachsende Wasserstoffinfrastruktur als Basis für
einen größeren Betriebsradius und mehr in Betrieb befindliche Brennstoffzellen-LKWs erforderlich.
Die Wasserstoff-Infrastruktur als Teil des H2-Ecosystems, bei dem cellcentric aktiv unterstützt.

[ Mehr erfahren][22]
[Ein blauer Lichtstrahl leuchtet auf einem schwarzen Hintergrund.]

Um das Video abspielen zu können, müssen Sie Marketing-Cookies akzeptieren.

# Fuel cell systems and electrolysers for decarbonising energy

Convion Ltd. is a leading fuel cell system developer commercializing solid oxide fuel cell systems
for distributed power generation in industrial and commercial applications. Our products are
designed for premium energy efficiency, reliability and operational flexibility. As a part of HD
Hydrogen, Convion provides its global customers with sustainable power generation solutions for
power security, energy independence and unparalleled fuel economy

Convion’s mission is to support  sustainable energy transition with high temperature electrochemical
solutions based on solid oxide cell (SOC) technology. Solid oxide fuel cells at the heart of our
power generating products are ideal for distributed and small scale power generation. They make
possible clean, dependable power generation at superb electrical efficiency at any scale, and
co-locating zero local emission power generation with consumption. Convion’s proven, proprietary
system technology facilitates broad fuel flexibility with no compromise in efficiency. In hydrogen
production, solid oxide electrolysis by Convion’s technology offers unparalleled efficiency and
scalability to meet industrial demand.

# A Clean Future

The Fuel Cell and Hydrogen Energy Association (FCHEA) is the national hydrogen industry trade
association with a mission to advance the commercial production, distribution and use of hydrogen in
the United States and beyond.  

[Become a Member Today][32]

## About FCHEA

For over 35 years FCHEA has provided a consistent industry voice to policymakers and regulators,
driving support at the federal and state level. Our educational efforts promote the environmental
and economic benefits of hydrogen energy and fuel cell technologies to a range of stakeholders.

[Learn More About FCHEA][33]

# [Unified Vision][34]

# [Record of Success][35]

# [Driving Support][36]

## Our Work

FCHEA leads national efforts to encourage government support for hydrogen and fuel cell technology.
This helps give the industry a voice in shaping policies and regulations to ensure safe and
successful commercial growth. We also educate the public and policymakers about the economic and
environmental benefits of these technologies.

[Explore Our Work][41]

## Hydrogen Learning Center

Understand how this clean, efficient energy source is driving innovation and sustainability in
various industries. Delve into the science behind hydrogen, its applications, and its role in
creating a robust energy economy.

[Learn More][42]

# [Hydrogen Basics][43]

# [Hydrogen Production][44]

# [Fuel Cell Basics][45]

# [Transportation][46]

# [Industrial Applications][47]

## Our Members

FCHEA has a diverse and international membership encompassing the full spectrum of the hydrogen
economy, including the various pathways of production, distribution, and storage, as well as use in
fuel cells, turbines, and other technologies for all modes of transportation, power generation,
industrial processes, and more.

# A Clean Future

The Fuel Cell and Hydrogen Energy Association (FCHEA) is the national hydrogen industry trade
association with a mission to advance the commercial production, distribution and use of hydrogen in
the United States and beyond.  

[Become a Member Today][32]

## About FCHEA

For over 35 years FCHEA has provided a consistent industry voice to policymakers and regulators,
driving support at the federal and state level. Our educational efforts promote the environmental
and economic benefits of hydrogen energy and fuel cell technologies to a range of stakeholders.

[Learn More About FCHEA][33]

## Our Work

FCHEA leads national efforts to encourage government support for hydrogen and fuel cell technology.
This helps give the industry a voice in shaping policies and regulations to ensure safe and
successful commercial growth. We also educate the public and policymakers about the economic and
environmental benefits of these technologies.

[Explore Our Work][41]

## Hydrogen Learning Center

Understand how this clean, efficient energy source is driving innovation and sustainability in
various industries. Delve into the science behind hydrogen, its applications, and its role in
creating a robust energy economy.

industrial processes, and more.

## What are Fuel Cells and Electrolyzers?

This has to be one of our most frequently asked questions. No need to worry. FuelCellsEtc is here to
clarify!

Fuel cells and electrolyzers are electrochemical cells that are often used in conjunction to store
and reproduce electricity. Fuel cells consume a fuel and oxidant to generate electricity.
Electrolyzers, on the other hand, consume electricity and water to split the water into its hydrogen
and oxygen components.

Fuel cells are different than batteries. Since batteries carry their reactive material in the
electrodes and are hermetically sealed. There is no fuel or oxidant that needs to be brought into
the battery. Fuel cells, on the other hand, are very dynamic and have the fuel stored outside of the
fuel cell stack. The fuel and oxidant are then transferred to the stack continually while the stack
is generating power. This means that the amount of energy that can be delivered by the fuel cell is
only limited by the amount of fuel stored externally, while a battery can only deliver as much
energy as the fuel contained within it.

Whether your needs are in the standard fuel cell and electrolyzer or some other niche application,
you will find our expertise and knowledge at your service.

## **Clean Energy Through Hydrogen**

Hydrogen refuelling systems for transport, including compression, high-pressure storage and
dispensing, and off-grid fuel cell solutions for reliable power.

# Off-Grid & Hydrogen Power Solutions

## Hydrogen Refuelling

We offer a wide range of hydrogen refuelling products including static and modular refuelling. We
can also provide on-site hydrogen production. Our products can fuel any hydrogen powered vehicle be
it planes, trains or automobiles.

[ Find out more ][75]
[EFOY M10 fuel cartridge, EFOY fuel cell, and EFOY battery in a row against white background.]

## Fuel Cell Products

Our fuel cell selection includes a broad range of clean, quiet, and reliable products, ideal for
powering off-grid applications such as CCTV towers, environmental monitoring equipment, traffic
signs and parking equipment.

[ Find out more ][76]

Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also

faster quoting, and the ability to deliver customized products at scale.

## Discover IREC

Learn who we are and how our research drives innovation in sustainable energy.

## Who we are

IREC is a public research centre within the CERCA system, founded in 2008 and dedicated to research,
development, innovation and demonstration in sustainable energy.

Our work spans the full scope of the energy transition, from fundamental science to applied
research, with the aim of generating knowledge that is relevant to industry, public administrations
and society. Through collaboration with research groups, institutions and companies, we help drive
the energy transition and strengthen the role of science in building a cleaner and more resilient
future.

## Who we are

IREC is a public research centre within the CERCA system, founded in 2008 and dedicated to research,
development, innovation and demonstration in sustainable energy.

Our work spans the full scope of the energy transition, from fundamental science to applied
research, with the aim of generating knowledge that is relevant to industry, public administrations
and society. Through collaboration with research groups, institutions and companies, we help drive
the energy transition and strengthen the role of science in building a cleaner and more resilient
future.

مجله ***مکانیک سازه ها و شاره ها*** آمادگی انتشار مقالات تخصصی در کلیه زمینه های مهندسی مکانیک و
مباحث میان رشته ای مرتبط با این شاخه علمی را دارا است. لذا از کلیه اساتید، دانشجویان، پژوهشگران و
فعالین صنعت دعوت می شود که حاصل تحقیقات جدید، پژوهش های بنیادین و ایده های نو خود را جهت انتشار به
این نشریه ارسال نمایند. شایان ذکر است که این مجله دارای رویکرد یکسان در دعوت از تحقیقات دارای جنبه
عددی، تحلیلی و آزمایشگاهی است. همچنین امکان انتشار مقالات جدید در زمینه روشهای عددی و تحلیلی (شامل هر
دو دیدگاه معین و تصادفی) در مهندسی مکانیک فراهم شده است. در پایان خاطر نشان می شود که سیاست اصلی این
مجله بر تسریع فرآیند داوری و تعیین تکلیف مقالات در حداقل زمان ممکن استوار شده است.


 نشریۀ «***مکانیک سازه ها و شاره ها***» به صاحب امتیازی [دانشگاه صنعتی شاهرود][48]؛ به‌طور کامل
الزامات انتشار دسترسی آزاد را طبق [مجوز کریتیو کامنز تخصیص 4.0 بین المللی][49] رعایت می‌کند.  بر طبق
این مجوز کاربران اجازه دارند اقدامات خواندن، دانلود، کپی، اشتراک‌گذاری، چاپ، جستجو و برقراری لینک با
متن کامل مقالات را انجام دهند. لازم به ذکر است متن کامل مقالات منتشرشده به صورت رایگان و بدون نیاز به
ثبت‌نام در نشریه در اختیار خوانندگان قرار دارد.
 

نشریه پایبند به قوانین بین المللی علیه سوء استفاده علمی شامل داده سازی، تحریف، سرقت ادبی، و غیره می
باشد. هرگونه سوء رفتار مشکوک در طی مرور و پروسه داوری، مطابق با دستورالعمل بین المللی کمیته اخلاق چاپ
آثار علمی (COPE) مورد بررسی قرار خواهد گرفت.

 

 

دوماهنمامه ***مکانیک سازه ها و شاره ها با همکاری انجمن ساخت و تولید ایران*** به صورت آزاد و بدون 
اخذ هزینه ارسال مقاله از نویسندگان، بصورت رایگان در دسترس خوانندگان و نویسندگان است.

 

مقالات ارسالی از طریق سامانۀ [همانندجو][50]  مشابه‌یابی می‌شوند و چکیده مبسوط انگلیسی مقالات از طریق
سامانه iThenticate مشابه یابی می­شوند.

عددی، تحلیلی و آزمایشگاهی است. همچنین امکان انتشار مقالات جدید در زمینه روشهای عددی و تحلیلی (شامل هر
دو دیدگاه معین و تصادفی) در مهندسی مکانیک فراهم شده است. در پایان خاطر نشان می شود که سیاست اصلی این
مجله بر تسریع فرآیند داوری و تعیین تکلیف مقالات در حداقل زمان ممکن استوار شده است.

ثبت‌نام در نشریه در اختیار خوانندگان قرار دارد.

باشد. هرگونه سوء رفتار مشکوک در طی مرور و پروسه داوری، مطابق با دستورالعمل بین المللی کمیته اخلاق چاپ

این نشریه ارسال نمایند. شایان ذکر است که این مجله دارای رویکرد یکسان در دعوت از تحقیقات دارای جنبه
عددی، تحلیلی و آزمایشگاهی است. همچنین امکان انتشار مقالات جدید در زمینه روشهای عددی و تحلیلی (شامل هر
دو دیدگاه معین و تصادفی) در مهندسی مکانیک فراهم شده است. در پایان خاطر نشان می شود که سیاست اصلی این
مجله بر تسریع فرآیند داوری و تعیین تکلیف مقالات در حداقل زمان ممکن استوار شده است.


 نشریۀ «***مکانیک سازه ها و شاره ها***» به صاحب امتیازی [دانشگاه صنعتی شاهرود][48]؛ به‌طور کامل
الزامات انتشار دسترسی آزاد را طبق [مجوز کریتیو کامنز تخصیص 4.0 بین المللی][49] رعایت می‌کند.  بر طبق
این مجوز کاربران اجازه دارند اقدامات خواندن، دانلود، کپی، اشتراک‌گذاری، چاپ، جستجو و برقراری لینک با
متن کامل مقالات را انجام دهند. لازم به ذکر است متن کامل مقالات منتشرشده به صورت رایگان و بدون نیاز به
ثبت‌نام در نشریه در اختیار خوانندگان قرار دارد.
 

نشریه پایبند به قوانین بین المللی علیه سوء استفاده علمی شامل داده سازی، تحریف، سرقت ادبی، و غیره می
باشد. هرگونه سوء رفتار مشکوک در طی مرور و پروسه داوری، مطابق با دستورالعمل بین المللی کمیته اخلاق چاپ
آثار علمی (COPE) مورد بررسی قرار خواهد گرفت.

 

 

دوماهنمامه ***مکانیک سازه ها و شاره ها با همکاری انجمن ساخت و تولید ایران*** به صورت آزاد و بدون 
اخذ هزینه ارسال مقاله از نویسندگان، بصورت رایگان در دسترس خوانندگان و نویسندگان است.

 

مقالات ارسالی از طریق سامانۀ [همانندجو][50]  مشابه‌یابی می‌شوند و چکیده مبسوط انگلیسی مقالات از طریق
سامانه iThenticate مشابه یابی می­شوند.

[ محاسبه مقاومت شناور سه‌بدنه و تخمین عدم قطعیت در شرایط آب آرام بواسطه روش‌های آزمایشگاهی و عددی][52]

# ABOUT US

## INTRODUCTION

Shanghai LifenGas Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise that specializes in the production of gas
separation and purification equipment with a focus on energy efficiency and environmental
protection. Our product portfolio includes:
**- Argon recovery units with high recovery rates**
**- Energy-efficient cryogenic air separation units **
**- Energy-saving PSA & VPSA nitrogen and oxygen generators**
-**Small & Medium Scale LNG Liquefaction Unit(or System)**
**- Helium recovery units**
**- Carbon dioxide recovery units**
**- Volatile organic compound (VOC) treatment units**
**- Waste acid recovery units**
**- Wastewater treatment units**
These products have extensive applications across various industries such as the photovoltaic,
steel, chemical, powder metallurgy, semiconductor, and automotive sectors.

### Clean Energy Proof at Automotive Proving Grounds

Automotive proving grounds are essential for validating next-generation vehicles. Whether simulating
real-world conditions or preparing EV fleets for shipment, these facilities demand dependable,
high-capacity power.

in remote or flexible testing environments.

This mobile hydrogen-powered unit delivers both DC fast charging and AC site power, enabling EV
fleet charging up to 32% faster than conventional solutions. Beyond vehicles, HydroCharge powers
lighting, equipment, and other critical infrastructure, all from a quiet, zero-emission system.

Result: Faster vehicle turnaround, lower emissions, and less operational downtime in a rugged test
environment.
